title: fix: panel settle eases slowly after a short drag

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: panel settle eases slowly after a short drag

description: A short flick leaves almost no finger travel, so the full-velocity spring finished in a few frames and read as no animation. The settle now uses StiffnessLow and inherits 25% of the release velocity (direction and a little momentum kept). Device trace of a 155 px injected downward drag: offset 905 -> 720 over ~500 ms in steps of 8 to 1 px per frame. JVM green.
changed: fix: panel settle eases slowly after a short drag
